added.name: Lapel
added.long_description:
Great service means knowing your customers and making every interaction count. Online, that gets harder as a company grows. Customer context is scattered across systems, leaving teams to piece it together.

Lapel unifies that data into a real-time picture of every account and helps teams turn what they know into coordinated action across the customer journey. The result is faster decisions, more proactive service, and interactions that feel more personal. We call it hospitality at scale.

Learn more at lapel.com.

added.name: UFO.ai
added.long_description:
UFO is the operating platform for your business built by the creators of Github Copilot and Perplexity Computer. 

UFO learns your company, goals, tools, and workflows. UFO builds what your team needs to keep work moving.

added.name: Vexo
added.long_description:
Every AI today waits for a prompt. Vexo already has the context: the restaurant a friend mentioned, the intro you promised, the idea you had on a walk. It turns what it hears into private memories and acts on them, booking the table, sending the follow-up, and ordering the groceries through the apps you already use.

It's a woven bracelet with a microphone and health sensors. No screen, and nothing to open.

Vexo never keeps your audio. Only you can see your memories, and you can delete them anytime.
added.one_liner: An AI bracelet that remembers your day and acts before you ask.

added.name: Clean
added.long_description: Clean watches your market and finds your buyers from what companies actually do: customs shipments, permits, loans and supplier switches. Not just ads or web clicks.
added.one_liner: Origination engine for deal transactional flow.

added.name: HABU
added.long_description:
HABU is an AI-native real estate development firm that helps real estate investors deploy capital to build housing faster, at lower cost, and with higher yield. 

We're building an internal AI-native operating system that completes 90%+ of development tasks at 95% faster processing speeds while delivering the same outcomes customers expect externally: high yield, low risk projects. We're selling the outcome, not the inputs to the outcome. 

Developers are service providers for white-collar investors: they find land, construct buildings, and operate and sell them for a profit. Our customers don't care how the projects are sourced or managed, only that they are completed on time and produce the forecasted returns. 

We use agentic workflows, geospatial analysis and mapping, and development-specific workflow automation to manage the end-to-end process. The result is 5x more projects per FTE compared to a non-AI developer, 20% faster project schedules, and 10-15% lower total project costs. 

We're *not* long term property owners, strictly the service provider (fee/merchant developer).

$160B was deployed into multifamily in 2025 and $534B into commercial real estate overall. Developers naturally have high operating margins and we are building to be the most operationally and capital efficient developer in the country. 

Starting first with multifamily in Phoenix and then expanding nationally.
added.one_liner: Like Crosby, but for real estate development

long_description.before:
Asseta is an online marketplace for used capital equipment and parts.  We utilize innovative software to bring buyers and sellers together so you can efficiently and transparently collaborate during equipment transactions.  Our web based platform ensures easy price discovery for interested parties and high touch customer service.

Today over $100B is spent on used manufacturing equipment offline via brokers and middlemen. This huge but un-sexy market has yet to be transformed by technology. The incumbent firms rely on large sales forces and the fragmentation of the market to charge huge margins.   We believe in a better solution.


Founded in 2013, Asseta is Y Combinator backed startup based in Newport Beach.  For more information, visit www.asseta.com.

Check out our AngelLilst profile here:  https://angel.co/asseta?ref=startup_card
long_description.after:
Asseta helps semiconductor fabs buy spare parts for their production tools. A buyer sends Asseta the part number. The request goes to the suppliers in Asseta's network who list that part. When none of them has it, Asseta's AI sourcing team contacts suppliers who have carried the part before and searches beyond its listings. Buyers and suppliers never see each other; Asseta issues the quote and the invoice, pays the supplier, and manages every order.

Asseta has completed more than 30,000 part sales since 2014 and carries 450,000+ part and equipment listings from fabs, refurbishers, and dealers. Customers include large semiconductor manufacturers in the United States and abroad.

Founded in 2013 and based in Newport Beach, California. https://www.asseta.com/how-it-works

one_liner.before: Marketplace for industrial spare parts and capital equipment.
one_liner.after: Sourcing marketplace for semiconductor fab spare parts.

long_description.before:
A web app that offers live online courses in programming, design, data, online marketing and more.

Our courses are nearly as affordable as online Moocs (~$40 a month) and as effective as Bootcamps. We achieve this by running 100 person live classes with one expert professor and one mentor per 15 students. Every class, students need to turn in assignments that are corrected by their mentors and at the end of the course they need to turn in and approve a final project. We also help our selected students with careers services such as mockup interviews, Linkedin enhancement, and more. All of this creates a level of accountability that allows us to achieve really low churn levels (<9%).

Our career tracks last between 9-11 months and we give our selected students their money back in case they don't get a job 6 months after they are done with the course.
long_description.after: Coderhouse is Latin America’s largest live online learning community, with 500k+ alumni. We run live online tech cohorts taught by practitioners from companies like Google, Apple, Meta, and Tesla. On top of live classes, AI agents give each student personal feedback, practice, and support at scale, so learning stays hands-on without losing the human teacher. Students ship real projects and leave with skills they can use on the job. We’re expanding into the US with courses like AI Engineering and Data Analytics.

one_liner.before: Effective and accessible online live education.
one_liner.after: Live online courses that turn learners into builders

long_description.before:
At Toma, we are building the AI software suite for underserved industries, starting with Automotive.

We started as a voice AI infrastructure company and still are our own biggest customer to this day. Our product empowers hundreds of businesses with a world-class AI receptionist and customer support platform. Toma’s AI agents engage in thousands of customer interactions every day and generate millions of dollars worth of revenue.

Why Automotive first? It is a sleeping giant contributing trillions of dollars to the GDP. The industry and its processes are ready for disruption. Toma is bringing AI to all operations in the industry while working hand-in-hand with some of the biggest names, such as the Car Dealership Guy, and public companies like Lithia Motors and AutoNatio. Toma is backed by the best investors in Silicon Valley, including Andreessen Horowitz and Y Combinator.

OpenFoundry is an open source platform that helps engineers build, deploy, and scale their open source AI stack 10x faster. Ship your AI stack with just one line of code. You could think of us as an open source alternative to Hugging Face.

Learn more and check out a demo of this in action in our Launch YC post: https://www.ycombinator.com/launches/KhY-openfoundry-developer-infrastructure-for-open-source-ai
long_description.after:
Overheard is an AI product researcher. Tell it what you're deciding, and it designs the study, interviews your users by voice, and comes back with an answer backed by what they actually said, with every finding linked to the quotes behind it.

Teams at fast-growing software companies make product calls every week, often without talking to users, because real research takes weeks. Overheard gets them an answer in days, so they ship the right thing sooner.

one_liner.before: The fastest developer experience for building on open source AI.
one_liner.after: An AI product researcher that interviews your users.

long_description.before:
telli is building AI voice agents that convert leads into sales opportunities for B2C companies. For example, a leading home-buying platform is using telli to fully automate their pre-qualification.

We are serving customers in energy, real estate, medical products, and home services.

You might think that these B2C companies want to do more self-serve and less outreach. But the truth is outbound calls are what really drive conversion. Historically, managing these calls has been complex and expensive—costing companies hundreds of thousands of dollars. With telli, for the first time, B2C companies can automate the role of a pre-sales agent, end to end.
long_description.after: telli is build AI to run customer-facing operations

long_description.before:
Roma is the task app where AI gets to work for you. Simply type or say anything - an idea, a thought, a bunch of different things you need to remember - and Roma starts the work from your pocket.

It's connected to your calendar, your email, your files, so it knows what to do next before you even ask.
long_description.after:
Roma is the to-do list that does itself. Two of our three founders have been through YC before: Jan built Loom (W12, acquired by Dropbox) and Tobi built Senic (S13, acquired by Gira).

Most of the work we do starts and ends with a task. So we're rebuilding something everyone already uses: the to-do list that becomes your everyday assistant, the one place that already knows everything you need done.

one_liner.before: The AI task app that gets to work for you.
one_liner.after: Roma is the to-do list that does itself

long_description.before: We produce the most capable, fast, and efficient coding agent harness. Our harness has 20k+ github stars, and $1m+/month of inference throughput.

It's built from the ground up with a different architecture to solve the memory bottleneck (it's 20x more memory efficient than Claude Code) that has kept agent swarms from going mainstream. long_description.before:
Tenor enables domain experts to build, run, and scale AI-native service businesses.
The next generation of successful white-collar service businesses will be built and scaled around AI from the ground up. These companies need more than capable AI models. They need a company data layer, governed workflows that AI can execute, and harnesses that continuously improve based on outcomes and decision checkpoints. Tenor is building this infrastructure so millions of AI-native businesses don’t have to build it themselves.
long_description.after: Tenor is a full-stack infrastructure for building and running AI-native businesses. We’re not just an agent framework, we manage the entire loop from how AI executes work to how every action, decision, and business outcome is captured and learned from. Owning the full stack lets companies deploy governed AI workflows, understand what actually drives results, and continuously improve how their business operates without building the infrastructure themselves.

one_liner.before: Infrastructure for building and scaling AI-native service businesses.
one_liner.after: Infrastructure for building and scaling AI-native businesses.
